'''DeMare''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during which he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="TOR" />
